Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Provide critical communications and tracking for multiple spacecraft from three complexes located globally, and operates year round 24 hours/7days to provide continuous contact with the spacecraft. The program fulfills NASA goals by supporting NASA deep space mission set, including NASA-funded missions and collaborative international missions.

Prepare internal and external compliance reports, including data analysis and trend summaries

Collaboration & Communication:

Represent the program in discussions with regulatory agencies and community stakeholders

Experience with construction safety oversight and managing shifting project priorities
Ability to analyze EHS data and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

Certified Safety Professional (CSP) or OHST/CHST (BCSP)

jobs.description:
About the Company

South Coast Community Services is a behavioral health nonprofit with over 40 years of history serving individuals, families, and youth across Southern California. SCCS delivers mental health services through county contracts with San Bernardino County and Orange County, managed care agreements, commercial insurance, and school district partnerships (NPA-certified). Our team of 400 includes more than 160 clinicians operating across San Bernardino and Orange Counties and beyond. SCCS accepts Medi-Cal, managed care, and commercial insurance plans.

About the Role

The Senior Data Analyst is responsible for supporting organizational decision-making through the development of reliable reporting, data analysis, and documentation of systems and data structures. This role works across clinical, operational, and financial datasets to produce accurate, actionable insights and maintain a clear understanding of how data flows across systems.

The position requires strong technical skills in SQL and Tableau, along with the ability to work with complex relational data environments, including behavioral health EHR systems. A key focus of this role is ensuring data clarity and consistency by documenting existing data sources, reporting logic, and system relationships, enabling more effective and scalable analytics across the organization. This role partners with stakeholders across Marketing, Customer Care, Finance, Clinical Operations, and IT to deliver reporting and analysis that supports day-to-day operations and ongoing performance improvement.

Responsibilities

Data Analysis and Reporting

Develop, maintain, and enhance Tableau dashboards and reports supporting referral tracking, intake performance, clinician activity, and program metrics.
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, join, and transform data from complex relational databases.
Produce recurring and ad hoc reports to support operational and strategic decision-making.
Ensure accuracy and consistency of reported data through validation and reconciliation processes.

Data Systems Documentation and Structure

Document current data systems, including data sources, table structures, field definitions, and relationships across systems.
Maintain clear documentation of reporting logic, metric definitions, and calculation methodologies.
Identify gaps or inconsistencies in data structures and escalate opportunities for improvement.
Support the development and maintenance of data dictionaries and internal documentation resources.

Data Quality and Integrity

Perform regular audits to identify data inconsistencies, missing values, or reporting discrepancies.
Partner with IT and operational teams to investigate and resolve data quality issues.
Ensure alignment between source system data (e.g., EHR, CRM, billing systems) and reporting outputs.

Cross-Functional Support

Collaborate with stakeholders to understand reporting needs and translate business questions into data queries and visualizations.
Support multiple departments including Marketing, Finance, Customer Care, and Clinical Operations with data requests and analysis.
Present findings in a clear, concise manner appropriate for both technical and non-technical audiences.

EHR and Data Environment Support

Work with behavioral health EHR data to support reporting and analysis needs.
Assist in extracting and validating data from EHR and connected systems.
Develop familiarity with system workflows and data capture processes to improve reporting accuracy.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields such as data analytics, statistics, mathematics, health informatics, or related discipline.
Minimum 3–5 years of experience in a data analyst or similar role.
Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex joins, aggregations, and data transformation.
Experience building dashboards and visualizations in Tableau or a similar BI tool.
Experience working with complex relational databases and multi-source data environments.
Demonstrated ability to document data systems, reporting logic, and workflows clearly and accurately.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and integrity.

Preferred Skills

Experience working in healthcare or behavioral health environments.
Familiarity with EHR systems and healthcare data structures.
Understanding of basic financial or operational metrics in a service-based organization.
Experience supporting cross-functional teams with reporting and analytics.

At Nevada Gold Mines, our vision is to be the world’s most valued gold mining business by finding, developing, and operating the best assets with the best people. We are committed to a safe work environment sending every person home safe and healthy every day and leaving a sustainable legacy on our host communities.

Oversee Geologic data collection (logging RC and Core)

Independently built and validates 3D geologic models. Implement new methods or refinements unique to deposit.
Ensure the timely completion of various daily, weekly, and monthly data reconciliation and analytics reports

Collate, analyze, and interpret data and write reports that identify possible answers and provide appropriate action to other departments in the business.

Fully qualified and experienced professional geologist or geological engineer who has considerable latitude for independent judgement, actions, and decisions, and has full professional competency.

Miami, Florida

Do you have strong computing and financial/data analysis skills? Do you thrive in innovative work environments that champion continuous process improvement? Are you an early stage professional or a recent graduate of a coding program and eager to put your skills to use? If so, we have a data analyst role on our Grants Administration & Finance team.

Knight Foundation’s Grants Administration team oversees and continuously improves the foundation’s grant making process and systems. Finance plans, manages, and forecasts the foundation’s financial resources, supporting budgeting and long-term financial planning in partnership with program and operational teams. We are seeking an individual with an interest in technical support, finance, data analysis and management.

As the Data Analyst supporting the Grants Administration and Finance team, you will report to our Manager of Grants Administration.

Key responsibilities:

Translates financial data into clear, decision-relevant insights that support programmatic and operational strategy, including identifying trends, interpreting results, and making actionable recommendations
Ensures the quality, integrity, and accuracy of grant data across grant, accounting, and finance platforms
Supports responsible fiduciary stewardship of grants, grant-related financial structures, and endowments
In partnership with program staff, supports the grant payment decisions based on timely and relevant financial data
Contributes to process improvements by identifying issues and suggesting solutions

Things we look for in a successful candidate:

Strong technical and analytical skills with an affinity for financial/business concepts and relationships
Detail-oriented and solutions-driven
Ability to ensure that projects are delivered on time and produce desired results
Programming/coding proficiency
Ability to navigate complexity and ambiguity
Skillful in creating narratives with data
Curiosity and a strong desire to learn
A strong orientation towards customer service

Experience with Fluxx, or another grants management database, is a plus.

About Knight Foundation

We ignite in every person the power to shape thriving communities.

John S. and James L. Knight believed that a well-informed community could best “determine its own true interests" and was essential to a well-functioning, thriving democracy. For 75 years, Knight Foundation has continued their work by supporting people, organizations and insights that lead to healthier communities. The foundation invests in journalism, arts and culture and community development in the 26 cities where the Knight brothers once published newspapers. Microsoft Office; Microsoft Projects (preferred)
Bluebeam
Microsoft Teams
Pioneer RMS
